responseMessageContents.text:
The version history / clock icon feature is part of the Rork platform interface, not something I build into your app. It should appear in the top area of the Rork editor/builder UI — typically near the project name or in a toolbar.

If you're not seeing it, I'd recommend reaching out to **Rork support** directly, as they can help troubleshoot your account/UI access. Since you're on the Max plan, you should have full access to version history.
